tool_schemas.name: get_historical_k_data
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches historical K-line (OHLCV) data for a Chinese A-share stock.

        Args:
            code: The stock code in Baostock format (e.g., 'sh.600000', 'sz.000001').
            start_date: Start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            end_date: End date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            frequency: Data frequency. Valid options (from Baostock):
                         'd': daily
                         'w': weekly
                         'm': monthly
                         '5': 5 minutes
                         '15': 15 minutes
                         '30': 30 minutes
                         '60': 60 minutes
                       Defaults to 'd'.
            adjust_flag: Adjustment flag for price/volume. Valid options (from Baostock):
                           '1': Forward adjusted (后复权)
                           '2': Backward adjusted (前复权)
                           '3': Non-adjusted (不复权)
                         Defaults to '3'.
            fields: Optional list of specific data fields to retrieve (must be valid Baostock fields).
                    If None or empty, default fields will be used (e.g., date, code, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, pctChg).

        Returns:
            A Markdown formatted string containing the K-line data table, or an error message.
            The table might be truncated if the result set is too large.

tool_schemas.name: get_stock_basic_info
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches basic information for a given Chinese A-share stock.

        Args:
            code: The stock code in Baostock format (e.g., 'sh.600000', 'sz.000001').
            fields: Optional list to select specific columns from the available basic info
                    (e.g., ['code', 'code_name', 'industry', 'listingDate']).
                    If None or empty, returns all available basic info columns from Baostock.

        Returns:
            A Markdown formatted string containing the basic stock information table,
            or an error message.

tool_schemas.name: get_dividend_data
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches dividend information for a given stock code and year.

        Args:
            code: The stock code in Baostock format (e.g., 'sh.600000', 'sz.000001').
            year: The year to query (e.g., '2023').
            year_type: Type of year. Valid options (from Baostock):
                         'report': Announcement year (预案公告年份)
                         'operate': Ex-dividend year (除权除息年份)
                       Defaults to 'report'.

        Returns:
            A Markdown formatted string containing the dividend data table,
            or an error message.

tool_schemas.name: get_adjust_factor_data
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches adjustment factor data for a given stock code and date range.
        Uses Baostock's "涨跌幅复权算法" factors. Useful for calculating adjusted prices.

        Args:
            code: The stock code in Baostock format (e.g., 'sh.600000', 'sz.000001').
            start_date: Start date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            end_date: End date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

        Returns:
            A Markdown formatted string containing the adjustment factor data table,
            or an error message.

            quarter: The quarter (1, 2, 3, or 4).

        Returns:
            Markdown table with profitability data or an error message.

tool_schemas.name: get_performance_express_report
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches performance express reports (业绩快报) for a stock within a date range.
        Note: Companies are not required to publish these except in specific cases.

        Args:
            code: The stock code (e.g., 'sh.600000').
            start_date: Start date (for report publication/update) in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            end_date: End date (for report publication/update) in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

        Returns:
            Markdown table with performance express report data or an error message.

tool_schemas.name: get_stock_industry
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches industry classification for a specific stock or all stocks on a given date.

        Args:
            code: Optional. The stock code (e.g., 'sh.600000'). If None, fetches for all stocks.
            date: Optional. The date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If None, uses the latest available date.

        Returns:
            Markdown table with industry classification data or an error message.

tool_schemas.name: get_trade_dates
tool_schemas.description: Returns the exchange trading dates between start_date and end_date (inclusive), defaulting to 2015-01-01 and today when omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when either date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format or start_date is after end_date, and NOT_FOUND when no trading calendar is available for the requested range.

tool_schemas.name: get_all_stock
tool_schemas.description: Lists all instruments covered by the server (A-shares and indices) with their name and trading status as of the given date (defaults to today), returning the full result set without pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, and NOT_FOUND when the server has no reference snapshot for that date.

tool_schemas.name: get_deposit_rate_data
tool_schemas.description:
Fetches benchmark deposit rates (活期, 定期) within a date range.

            end_date: Optional. End date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

            year_type: Optional. Year type for date filtering. '0' for announcement date (公告日期, default),

        Returns:

tool_schemas.name: get_latest_trading_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent trading date on the specified exchange calendar as of as_of_date (defaults to today in the server timezone); if as_of_date itself is a trading day, it is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when as_of_date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format or exchange is not one of sh/sz/bj/idx, and NOT_FOUND when the calendar for the requested exchange is unavailable.

as_of_date.description: Reference date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; if omitted, uses today in server timezone.

exchange.description: Exchange calendar to evaluate trading day against.

tool_schemas.name: get_market_analysis_timeframe
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns a recommended [start_date, end_date] timeframe for market analysis based on the server’s current real date, where end_date is the latest available trading date and the window length depends on period (recent/quarter/half_year/year). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when period is not one of the supported values, and NOT_FOUND when the server cannot determine a latest trading date from its trading calendar.

tool_schemas.name: get_stock_analysis
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns a data-driven analysis report (not investment advice) for the specified security code, using the requested analysis_type (fundamental/technical/comprehensive) and the latest available validated datasets. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when code is missing/invalid or analysis_type is unsupported, NOT_FOUND when the security code is unknown or required datasets are not available for that security, and CONFLICT when the security is delisted/suspended such that the requested analysis cannot be computed from available history.

tool_schemas.name: list_securities
tool_schemas.description: Lists A-share securities in the reference store with optional filters; returns a stable, paginated result set and refuses unknown filter enums.

listing_date_gte.description: Filter securities with listing_date >= this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

listing_date_lte.description: Filter securities with listing_date <= this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tool_schemas.name: update_security_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a security through its lifecycle by updating status; refuses invalid transitions and refuses changes for unknown bs_code.

code.description: Security code in Baostock format (e.g., 'sh.600000'); must resolve to securities.bs_code.

status.description: Target lifecycle status; must be a valid transition from the current status.

effective_date.description: Optional effective date for the status change (YYYY-MM-DD) for audit/traceability; does not backfill time-series.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the transition.

tool_schemas.name: update_trade_day
tool_schemas.description: Marks a calendar date as trade day or non-trade day; refuses invalid format and updates only the specified existing trading_date row.

is_trade_day.description: Whether the date is a trade day.

notes.description: Optional notes explaining the change (e.g., holiday adjustment).

tool_schemas.name: list_ingestion_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingestion jobs with filtering and pagination so callers can reproduce datasets by dataset_fingerprint and track validation outcomes; refuses unknown status/job_type enums.

created_at_gte.description: Filter jobs created at or after this timestamp (ISO-8601).

created_at_lte.description: Filter jobs created at or before this timestamp (ISO-8601).

tool_schemas.name: create_ingestion_job
tool_schemas.description: Creates an ingestion job to load/validate a vendor snapshot into the normalized store; returns the created job record and refuses invalid job_type/status or missing required parameters.

job_type.description: Type of ingestion work to run.

requested_params.description: Vendor/query parameters that define the requested snapshot (e.g., date range, datasets).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key; if repeated, the server returns the existing job for the same key and payload.

metadata.name: A-Share Market Data Server
metadata.description: This backend stores normalized A-share market reference data (securities, trading calendar, index constituents, industry classification) plus time-series datasets (OHLCV K-line, adjust factors, corporate actions/dividends, financial statements, and macro/interest-rate series). Read tools query these
